content: You can carefully remove the rivets using a small side-cutting plier. The snap rivet remover and others wear out so quickly that they stop working properly after just a few rivets. This method also works much better than using the needle-nose pliers shown in the picture.

replies.content: Thank you for your comment. We had to mention the needle-nose pliers because that is a tool you received with the printer. Removing the rivets with side cutters and other methods are possible. Feel free to remove the rivets in a way that suits you best and that will not damage the printer.
